# Port Operations Simulator - Copilot Instructions

This is an Nx monorepo workspace with a Node.js TypeScript backend application for simulating tugboat operations in a port.

## Project Structure
- Monorepo managed by Nx
- Backend application: port-operations-simulator
- Technologies: Node.js, TypeScript, RabbitMQ

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all code
- Follow Nx workspace conventions
- Use RabbitMQ for message queuing
- Implement tugboat movement simulation logic
